en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the Imamasws is present at the funeral, so heasws would be the most rightful of the people with the Salaat upon it (the deceased)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If the Imam is present, he is the most deserving of all people to perform Salah (prayer) for a deceased person.’”
